offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry and thermal analysis instruments, plus consumables and software, for laboratories. Sells to pharmaceutical, biotech, food, environmental and chemical customers, and provides service plans and informatics software.

primary_products.value: liquid chromatography systems; mass spectrometers; thermal analysis and rheology instruments; chromatography columns and lab consumables; laboratory informatics software

primary_services.value: instrument service and maintenance contracts; calibration and compliance support; training

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical, biotech, food, environmental, chemical and materials testing laboratories; B2G: government and public health laboratories, universities

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; food and beverage testing; environmental testing; chemicals and materials

revenue_model.value: product sales: analytical instruments, software licenses and recurring consumables such as columns and vials; service fees: service contracts, repair, calibration and training

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and consumables from purchased components, sold to laboratories; software / platform: informatics and instrument control software for lab data management

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific including China and India, and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, thermal analysis, consumables and software for laboratories

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and service staff selling instruments to laboratories; distributors / dealers: regional distributors in smaller markets; online: e-commerce for consumables and parts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customers use products in FDA, EPA and GxP regulated settings, company subject to quality and export rules

notes: Waters announced a combination with BD's biosciences and diagnostics business; not included because its status is uncertain.
